subject: history
concept: Understanding how an ancient civilization was governed (kings, pharaohs, councils) at a basic level
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student role-plays a simple decision a ruler or council might have had to make for their people
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an ancient leadership role to a simplified description of their responsibilities
exercise.abstract: Student explains one job a described ancient leader had

misconception_flags: assumes all ancient civilizations were governed identically

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
